verdict.rationale: Numeral tracks nexus position and liability exposure per jurisdiction (economic thresholds, current sales/transaction counts) and offers filing/registration automation, giving a finance lead visibility into where tax is owed. However, there is no explicit evidence of a 'collected vs owed' reconciliation view, filing-ready jurisdiction-level accrual reports, or structured exports designed for accountants/GL systems — integrations only mention recording transactions back for filing/nexus monitoring, not GL-formatted exports. Missing for 10: explicit collected-vs-owed liability report, GL/accountant export format documentation, dedicated accrued-liability dashboard.
